delay_reason: a signal card answers the moment it names

plausibility.fresh_reason: the card is about the account arriving, so its subject is one week old by definition

_note: Subject of `event_on_action_bindings`. It is the `customer_added` binding's only consumer, which is also what makes EvSignals connect that signal at all: the engine listens to exactly the signals the loaded catalogue triggers on. `musteri.count == 1` is the whole "first customer" pattern — the signal says an account arrived, the count says it is the first — and the second account is refused at G7 rather than by a latch, which is why the latch is a zero cooldown.
